description_en: Queries the database links of a PolarDB for Oracle cluster
description_zh: 查询PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）集群的DBLink信息
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-db-links --db-cluster-id pc-a0000000000000 --db-link-name dblink_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBLinks

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster for which you want to query the database links.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173433.html operation to query PolarDB clusters
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询DBLink的集群ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173433.html接口查看PolarDB集群列表
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database link. If you leave this parameter empty, the system returns all the database links
parameters.name: db_link_name

DBInstanceName.description_en: The ID of the source cluster that the database link connects

DBLinkName.description_en: The name of the database link

SourceDBName.description_en: The name of the source database of the database link

TargetAccount.description_en: The account of the destination database of the database link

TargetDBInstanceName.description_en:
The ID of the destination cluster that the database link connects.

If the destination cluster is not a PolarDB for Oracle cluster, the returned value is empty
TargetDBInstanceName.description_zh:
DBLink的目标集群ID。

如果目标不是PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）集群，则该参数为空

TargetDBName.description_en: The name of the destination database of the database link
